Admission needs an inland pilot's licence. The node reads it against the national register of masters and checks the sea service log: days aboard, vessel names, the master's signature. One licence, one seat; a forged entry voids the cohort.

Ninety days on watched water is the fee, plus 150 dollars medical, 125 credential, 95 filing. Fifty seats need fifty bodies that stood them: 4,500 person-days on the river before a payout. A lotus pond photo proves the pond.

A sparrow lands on the rail in any weather; the pilot carries which sandbars the flood moved, and no paper carries it.
